verdict.rationale: IDE integration is a fair axis for a terminal coding agent, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions JetBrains, interactive diff viewing in an IDE, or sharing selected code from an IDE as context. The pack covers only CLI features such as MCP, GEMINI.md, --include-directories and output formats.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
